The config was net7.0-windows-Release-x64-CoreCLR_release-(Windows.10.Amd64.ServerRS5.Open)windows.10.amd64.serverrs5.open
I think it might even be the same machine that ran the tests, failures are:
- https://dev.azure.com/dnceng/public/_build/results?buildId=1899254&view=results
- https://dev.azure.com/dnceng/public/_build/results?buildId=1899753&view=results
